controlName: AI Risks and Benefits From Third-Party Entities Are Managed
purpose: Ensures third-party AI risks are actively managed on an ongoing basis, not just assessed once at procurement and then forgotten.
summary: AI risks and benefits from third-party entities are managed, including regularly reviewing third-party risks against organizational risk tolerance and having contingency processes in place for handling third-party AI system failures or high-priority risks.
expectedStatementElements: How third-party AI risks are reviewed on an ongoing basis, not just at initial procurement
How third-party risk levels are compared against the organization's stated risk tolerance
What contingency processes exist if a third-party AI component fails or introduces a high-priority risk
Who owns the relationship and ongoing risk monitoring for each third-party AI dependency
evidenceExamples: Third-party AI risk review schedule and records
Documented risk tolerance criteria applied to third-party AI relationships
Contingency plan for third-party AI system failure or risk escalation
Ownership assignment for each third-party AI vendor relationship
commonGaps: Third-party AI risk was assessed once at procurement and never revisited
No defined risk tolerance exists to compare third-party AI risk against
No contingency plan exists if a critical third-party AI vendor fails or is compromised
No one is clearly responsible for ongoing monitoring of a given third-party AI relationship
interviewQuestions: When did you last review the risk from your third-party AI vendors, versus just at initial signing?
How do you know if a third-party AI vendor's risk level is within your organization's tolerance?
What's your contingency plan if a critical third-party AI vendor has an outage or security incident?
Who owns the ongoing relationship and risk monitoring for each of your AI vendors?
